name: Bookworm
notes: DRAFT for C13-3 (bestiary-plan.md). Tunnels under the floor and pops up near you. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (R-BAL-8). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
tell: a dirt bump moves toward you, then red circle
senseiLine: Watch the bump. Then step aside.
description: Tunnels under the floor and pops up near you.

bestiary.tip: Step off the bump, then calm it when it pops up.

lore.brown: A curious worm who loved reading. Calm it, and it curls up with a good book.
